subject.title: fix: resolve Codex fork duplication when parent is unresolved (#2108)

question: Should unresolved-parent sibling rows be deduplicated by task-derived turn IDs now, or should CodexBar retain the accepted fail-open policy until the complete fork-family provenance ledger exists?
rationale: Current main intentionally retains ambiguous sibling usage to avoid silent undercount, while this PR changes that accounting policy and the reviewed turn-ID provenance is not yet reliable across cache transitions.

options.title: Keep fail-open and finish provenance
options.body: Preserve current behavior and require a stable cross-file event identity plus ownership-migration ledger before suppressing missing-parent sibling rows.

options.title: Accept turn-ID deduplication
options.body: Allow the narrower turn-ID strategy only after all three correctness defects are fixed and live initial/repeat-scan proof demonstrates no legitimate child usage is lost.

options.title: Pause this PR
options.body: Leave the broader work on https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/issues/2037 and close or supersede this branch if the safer provenance design proceeds elsewhere.

recommendation.title: Keep fail-open and finish provenance
recommendation.body: Preserve current behavior and require a stable cross-file event identity plus ownership-migration ledger before suppressing missing-parent sibling rows.

likelyOwner.reason: They documented and merged the current fail-open invariant and performed the adjacent runtime proof pass.
